title: Remove agent-availability and 'Queued'-status logic from all ticket-assignment c
description:
Remove the use of agent availability or a “Queued” status anywhere. Assignment depends only on Preference and round-robin order.

Remove the unconditional Pending → Assigned change from the pre-commit hook. Status should become Assigned only in the post-commit hook, after an agent is actually selected.
If no active agent matches the ticket’s Category, keep the status as Pending and leave Assigned To empty.
